task_completion.description: Agent opens the Terminal activity or Pippy (Python IDE) to begin the task.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Terminal window or Pippy IDE interface is visible on the Sugar desktop.

task_completion.description: Agent accesses or displays the content of /home/ga/Documents/volcanoes.csv.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code in the editor or a 'cat' command in the terminal showing the CSV headers: Volcano Name, Country, Type, Latitude, Longitude, Elevation.

task_completion.description: Agent writes code to filter for 'Stratovolcano' (case-insensitive) and Elevation > 3000.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visible Python code or script logic showing a conditional check for 'stratovolcano' in the Type column and a numerical comparison for elevation > 3000.

task_completion.description: Agent writes code to format the output as a KML file with the required XML tags and coordinate order.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code showing the construction of <Placemark>, <name>, <description>, and <coordinates> tags, specifically ensuring longitude comes before latitude.

task_completion.description: Agent executes the script and verifies the creation of /home/ga/Documents/high_stratovolcanoes.kml.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command like 'ls' showing the new file exists, or a 'cat' command displaying the final KML content with the correct XML header and data.

integrity.description: The agent should not manually type out the KML file content without running a script.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should check if the agent executed a script (Python or Bash) rather than just using a text editor to manually transcribe the data.

integrity.description: The agent interacts with the Sugar Learning Platform UI elements.
integrity.visual_evidence: Mouse cursor movements, highlighting of text, or clicking on activity icons in the Sugar ring/frame.

integrity.description: The agent uses the provided CSV file path rather than hardcoding external data.
integrity.visual_evidence: The script or command must explicitly reference '/home/ga/Documents/volcanoes.csv'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The final KML file must contain exactly 7 volcanoes: Cotopaxi, Fuji, Popocatepetl, Kilimanjaro, Chimborazo, Pico de Teide, and Erebus. The coordinates in the <coordinates> tag MUST be in 'Longitude,Latitude' order. The description tag must follow the format 'Country: X, Elevation: Y m'. Any volcano with an elevation of 3000 exactly or a type other than Stratovolcano (e.g., Shield Volcano) must be excluded.
